purpose: Mark pre-fix editing outputs as INVALID and exclude them from any aggregation, table, or figure. Produced 2026-07-26 after the B-edit editing-sampler correctness audit.
why_stale: These runs went through AnalyticPancakeQuotientSampler BEFORE the audit fixes. Two defects make their editing/composition numbers structurally uninformative: (1) the sampler dropped the editing-capability flags, so it enumerated the DE-NOVO vocabulary rather than any editing vocabulary (fixed in A1); and (2) the de-novo tree-graft path uses a raw-partition + survival normalization (Zr+survival) that does not equal the quotient measure the GM loss trains (Zq) [A7, pre-existing, open]. They also predate any B-edit checkpoint, so they measured an editing/composition objective on a de-novo base that cannot edit real leads. Result was a negative HV delta and must not be cited as evidence about the editing paradigm.

stale_outputs.rerun_after: a verified B-edit checkpoint exists and the editing controller runs on the post-fix pancake sampler (A1+A2), with the A7 tree-graft convention decided
